Thus delete import org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension; and @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class). Also remove unused import org.junit.jupiter.api.extension.ExtendWith? That import remains but not used; we can remove it as well.

Check other imports: java.lang.reflect.Method, static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.*, JUnit param test imports, Stream, etc. All good.

Also note some assertions have messages maybe minor but fine.

Thus produce corrected code.
